summary: Youxin Technology Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $6,355,771 in Class A ordinary shares through Aegis Capital Corp. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415, not a special situation. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change elements. The offering is a standard equity financing to raise capital via an ATM program listed on Nasdaq under symbol YAAS. The registrant's role is issuer; the filing reflects an ordinary securities sale, not a transformative event. Terms include a 3.0% commission to Aegis, no escrow arrangement, and reliance on General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3 limiting the amount to one-third of non-affiliate public float. What to watch: market absorption of shares and potential dilution; no risk-arb angle as this is not a merger or tender.
